weights: network-equal mean of station-year complete-year Bq; reused masks in one year are one observation

success_criterion.population: river waterbodies with fully observed calendar-year reference; non-river objects are a transfer experiment and are not averaged into the river main result
success_criterion.primary_endpoint: hottest_30 absolute error on a complete calendar year
success_criterion.benefit: B_q = L_q(default climatology, truth) - L_q(policy, truth)
success_criterion.default: doy_climatology; reject means adopt this default
success_criterion.strong_simple_competitor: information-conditioned simple policy from Step 4: donor-only whenever donors are observed (right boundary not required); else air ridge when air exists; else linear interpolation for gaps of 30 days or shorter with both flanks; else smooth climatology
success_criterion.epsilon_justification: 0.05 C is below typical in-situ temperature probe accuracy (about 0.1-0.2 C) and is pre-specified from measurement precision, not from confirmation intervals. A policy may not lose more than this network-equal mean B_q relative to the strong simple competitor.
success_criterion.severe_error_definition: hottest-30 underestimate of the true complete-year peak greater than 1.0 C; diagnostic until an ecological threshold is independently justified
success_if_risk_control: network-equal mean B_q no worse than the strong simple competitor by more than 0.05 C on unseen river complete years
harm rate strictly lower than the strong simple competitor
same-adoption-rate random reject and a simple length/season threshold do not match the harm reduction
success_criterion.success_if_mean_benefit: network-equal mean B_q exceeds the strong simple competitor; this is an alternative claim and is not assumed
success_criterion.if_neither_passes: keep the training-mismatch diagnosis and simple-method applicability; do not claim a superior decision layer
success_criterion.reserved_unseen_pool: step1_universe candidate_unseen river complete station-years; do not use for rule selection
success_criterion.right_boundary_gate: donor-only does not need the right flank (prediction delta 0.0 C on 8 ARSO + 17 POWER development networks); interpolation does, and only for short gaps
success_criterion.air2stream: air2stream-3 (no daily discharge) is the air-only process control; the 8-parameter flow version is used only where discharge exists
